scope: JSON -ini files (ParamJSONFile::load through TOPPBase, before a run and for -write_ini), the parameter-XML -ini failures as the run-phase catch writes them (error stream and -log file), and FileInfo's forced type that the file contradicts. Tools: PeakPickerHiRes, FuzzyDiff, FileInfo.
method: ParamJSONFile.cpp, the vendored nlohmann::json 3.11.2 and TOPPBase.cpp read at the pins with git show. 62 cases executed against the C++ Release build by ../oracle/json-ini/cases.sh on ibminode06 in a clean environment per case (env -i, per-case HOME, OPENMS_HOME_PATH and cwd, OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON, OPENMS_DATA_PATH pinned), twice (run1 with 59 cases, run2 with all 62); the 59 common cases are identical between the runs after masking paths, log time stamps and timing figures. Seven more cases by cases3.sh (batch 3). run2 and batch 3 are retained under tests/data/topp_json_ini and replayed in process by tests/topp_json_ini.rs, which maps the Release run's paths to the replay's; what it does not compare as recorded is named in its module documentation.
evidence_tier: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential) against the Release build; the recorded differences (the wording of JSON syntax errors, the INI writer's floating-point text, two cases with an integer beyond 32 bits) are documented in docs/TOPP_CLI_SUPPORT.md, JSON INI files.
external_reference_note: The oracle drivers, inputs and result trees live under ../oracle/json-ini (run1, run2, run3); the remote copies ran under /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/oracle-runs/json-ini (results2 and results3 are the paths the retained files name).
